{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 的本机检索：文件名走 Everything、文档正文走 Anytxt，五个只读工具——让模型去搜你的盘，而不是猜一个路径。","id":"gh:1436619942","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-local-search","slug":"fishdivinity/dsh-local-search","topics":["anytxt","dsh-plugin","everything","local-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 的本机检索：文件名走 Everything、文档正文走 Anytxt，五个只读工具——让模型去搜你的盘，而不是猜一个路径。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Local Search for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**File names and document text from the whole machine, behind five read-only tools — so the model se"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"arches your disk instead of guessing a path.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · Install · Configuration · Tools · Security"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A session sees one folder. `grep` and `glob` are fast inside it and blind outside it, so when the wo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rk needs a file that lives anywhere else, the model either guesses a path or stops and asks you for "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"one — and the lookup goes back to you, in another window, with the conversation waiting."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Searching is not the expensive part. Picking the right hit, opening the document, reading the part t"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"hat matters, putting two of them side by side, and being able to say where the answer came from — th"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"at is. It is also exactly what a model is good at, once it can reach an index."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin gives it both: `es.exe` for file and folder **names** wherever Everything has indexed th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"em, Anytxt for the **text inside** PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, RTF, TXT and MD files. The whole sur"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"face is read-only — nothing writes, deletes, re-indexes, OCRs or starts an engine. A lookup is answe"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"red from the index those engines already built: milliseconds, not a rescan of the drive."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## When to use it"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **The search is a step, not the goal.** You asked for something else — a summary, a comparison, a "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"fix — and the answer needs a document you cannot point at. Handing that lookup back to yourself cost"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"s a window switch and a paste.
- **You know the answer, not the keyword.** "The price clause we agre"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ed with that supplier", "the note about this error". The model can try five phrasings in two languag"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"es, read the hits, and come back with the quote and the path.
- **The answer spans files.** "Compare"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" the payment terms in these two contracts", "what did the last three meeting notes decide about the "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"schedule". A search field returns a hit list; the reading and comparing is the part you wanted deleg"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ated.
- **The work is batch.** "List the counterparty in each of these 30 contracts" — no search fie"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ld does this. Search once, read every hit, write the table.
- **The file is not text.** `grep` canno"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"t open a PDF, a `.docx`, or a spreadsheet. Either the text comes through Anytxt, or you paste it in "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"by hand.
- **The answer has to cite a source.** A path plus a snippet can be checked; a plausible pa"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"e answer has to cite a source.** A path plus a snippet can be checked; a plausible paragraph cannot."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Why this exists

- License"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Tool | Engine | Use for |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `local_search_files` | Everything via `es.exe` | File/folder names, paths, cross-drive discovery |"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"
| `local_search_content` | Anytxt JSON-RPC | Text inside PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, RTF, TXT, MD "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"|
| `local_search_fragments` | Anytxt | Snippets around a match in one indexed file |
| `local_searc"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"h_read` | Anytxt | Extracted plain text of one indexed file, capped |
| `local_search_status` | both"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" | Check whether each engine is reachable |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Windows.
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0-0` — 0.2.1 and 0.2.2 (pre-releases included) run it;"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" 0.3 pre-releases are refused.
- Everything running, plus `es.exe` (a separate download from voidtoo"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ls; the plugin auto-detects PATH/common install folders, or set `files.everything.esPath`).
- Anytxt"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" Searcher for content search: the **GUI** (`ATGUI.exe`) must be running because the JSON-RPC service"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" lives inside it. The indexing service alone is not enough."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"This plugin does **not** bundle Everything, `es.exe`, or Anytxt. Install and license them separately"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"his plugin does **not** bundle Everything, `es.exe`, or Anytxt. Install and license them separately."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The command writes into one profile, and it has to be the profile the session boots from — the Deskt"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"op app owns `desktop`, `dsh web` owns `web`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`web` is a shipped template that initializes on first use; `desktop` must have been opened once, and"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" only the `dsh` bundled with the Desktop app can manage it. To install the source instead of the npm"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" tarball, swap the spec for `github:fishdivinity/dsh-local-search`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Security and limits"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Read-only**: no write, delete, index-sync, OCR, export, or settings operation is registered.
- `"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"es.exe` is always spawned with a fixed argv; model text goes after `--`, so `-export-*`, `-save-sett"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ings`, `-clear-settings`, `-exit`, `-reindex`, `-save-db`, and run-count switches are unreachable.
-"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" Anytxt is only called through `Search`, `GetResult`, `GetFragmentAll`, and `GetRawTextByFID`.
- No "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"network access except the configured local Anytxt URL.
- Results are capped; `local_search_read` cap"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"s the returned text.
- The plugin runs with the user's privileges and can read files the user can re"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ad. Search tools default to `all` (every available root); prefer `scope=workspace`/`work`/`personal`"},{"id":"p25s8","text":" or `path` when the search should stay in one tree."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- The engines are Windows-only today. The scope/path layer is already platform-aware (Windows drive "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"roots, macOS `/Users` + `/Volumes`, Linux `/home`), so labels and roots do not assume drive letters;"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" native backends for macOS/Linux are something we may add later. On those systems the tools still an"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"swer but report both engines as unavailable (`missing-tool` / `down`), and the card plus diagnostics"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" name the platform.
- The default scope is `all`: content search queries every default root (up to t"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"wo RPCs per root). If the configured `allRoots` are all missing (a drive unplugged), the call falls "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"back to the workspace and the result says so; a partially missing root is skipped and named in the r"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"esult.
- Everything 1.4 indexes metadata, not file contents; use Anytxt for contents.
- Anytxt's JSO"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"N-RPC API is local and unofficial; GUI versions can change behavior. The plugin reports unreachable/"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"wrong-shape responses instead of guessing.
- Anytxt's index may be stale. Verify important hits with"},{"id":"p27s11","text":" `read`/the original file.
- No auto-start: starting `ATGUI.exe` writes the index and is left to the"},{"id":"p27s12","text":" user.
- Anytxt's terms limit personal/non-commercial use; commercial use needs its own license."}],"truncated":true}
